# Camp Resource: Thrasher Field Dressing Station

This Thrasher put up a fight but now you get to eat well!

- Collects Meat over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Rad Turkey Field Dressing Station__

**Produces**

Brahmin Meat - 9.09%

Chicken Thigh - 9.09%

Mongrel Dog Meat - 9.09%

Fox Meat - 9.09%

Iguana Bits - 9.09%

Mole Rat Meat - 9.09%

Mutant Hound Meat - 9.09%

Radstag Meat - 9.09%

Radroach Meat - 9.09%

Squirrel Bits - 9.09%

Raw Wolf Meat - 9.09%

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

10 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Thrasher Field Dressing Station__ - 500 atoms

Atom Shop - __C.A.M.P. Resource Bundle__ - 1500 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Meat lasts X minutes in the collector**

135 minutes

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

6 Flamingo Units
